2. Health and safety

Swasth gives general fitness and nutrition information. It is not medical advice and does not replace a doctor, physiotherapist or dietitian. Talk to a professional before starting a new training or diet programme, especially if you have a medical condition, an injury or are pregnant. Stop exercising if you feel pain, dizziness or shortness of breath. Calorie, step, distance and other numbers are estimates. You train at your own risk.
